title: Google’s AI Didn’t Answer. It Built the App.
concept: The transition from 'AI as a chatbot' to 'AI as a software engineer.' The visual narrative moves from static text to functional, interactive-looking UI components that represent the Tabletop experience.
visual_language: Clean, high-contrast editorial aesthetic. Minimalist typography (sans-serif, bold weights). Color palette: Google-inspired primary accents (Blue, Red, Yellow, Green) against a neutral, premium off-white background.
hook_visual: A stark, full-bleed typographic treatment that breaks the 'app' paradigm immediately.
escalation: Starts with a conceptual prompt, moves to rapid-fire tool generation, shifts to collaborative UI, and concludes with a high-impact summary of the paradigm shift.
payoff: The final frame transforms the background to dark mode, signaling the 'new era' of software creation.
asset_requirements: UI mockups for itinerary, poll, and bracket tools

motion_direction.rhythm: Fast-paced, rhythmic cuts synced to the narration cadence.
motion_direction.staging_notes: Keep all critical UI elements within the center 80% of the screen to avoid UI overlap from platform overlays.

audio_direction.music_direction: Minimalist, tech-forward ambient track with a steady, driving pulse that builds intensity.

self_critique.assessment: The plan adheres to all constraints. The visual progression from text to UI cards effectively communicates the 'software on demand' concept. The pacing is tight, ensuring the 17.3s target is met without rushing the narration.
self_critique.adjustments_made: Ensured no camera moves were included; verified all SFX are from the allowed list; confirmed central composition for mobile optimization.
